title: Dinosaurs: Rulers of the Ancient World
description: A king of lizards, a rock from space, and a twist hiding in your backyard—dino facts for curious minds.

questions.question: What does 'Tyrannosaurus rex' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Tyrannos' is Greek for tyrant, 'sauros' means lizard, and 'rex' is Latin for king.

questions.question: The tyrant lizard king lived in which time period, the last age of the dinosaurs?
questions.hint: It starts with 'Cre-' and comes after the Jurassic
questions.explanation: T. rex lived near the very end of the Cretaceous—closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus!

questions.question: The Cretaceous ended 66 million years ago when what crashed into Earth?
questions.explanation: A space rock about 6 miles wide hit so hard it changed the climate of the whole planet.

questions.question: That asteroid left a giant buried crater near which Mexican peninsula?
questions.explanation: The Chicxulub crater is more than 100 miles across and lies partly under the sea off the Yucatán.

questions.question: After the Yucatán impact, one group of dinosaurs survived and still lives today—what are they?
questions.hint: Look up at the sky—or at a chicken!
questions.explanation: Birds are living dinosaurs. The pigeon on your sidewalk is a distant cousin of T. rex.
